snippet.title: Pegture – Official Gameplay Trailer (Old Version)
snippet.description:
Pegture is a peg solitaire-themed roguelike, deck-building game. Build your deck, enhance your pegs, perform frenetic combos, beat bosses, reach the highest score and get the best peg solitaire experience.

This trailer showcases Pegture’s core gameplay and mechanics.

We are a small indie team from Turkey, currently developing Pegture. Follow the channel to support us and see more development updates.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3355090/Pegture/
